steps.title: Analyze Layout Crash
steps.description: Inspect activity_main.xml to identify unsupported and non-standard UI elements causing the layout inflation crash.

steps.title: Fix Layout View Container
steps.description: Replace the unsupported CardView widget with a standard FrameLayout container to prevent immediate runtime layout inflation crashes.

steps.title: Optimize Resource Lookups
steps.description: Refactor MainActivity.java to use direct static R-class references instead of heavy dynamic reflection-based getIdentifier lookups.

steps.title: Refactor Build Dependencies
steps.description: Clean up build.gradle by removing unused external third-party dependencies, aligning with strict local compilation parameters.

steps.title: Verify Camera Permissions Flow
steps.description: Validate runtime camera access flows inside MainActivity for Android M+ devices to prevent security exceptions.

steps.title: Initialize TTS Handler
steps.description: Configure TextToSpeech engine initialization flow with UK/US voice fail-safe fallbacks.

steps.title: Optimize Surface Callback Handling
steps.description: Refine surface holder callback logic to handle device rotation and backgrounding states cleanly without breaking camera previews.

steps.title: Simulate OCR Processing Sequence
steps.description: Ensure the translation animation of the scanning line runs securely without blocking the primary UI thread.

steps.title: Verify Android Manifest Declarations
steps.description: Verify AndroidManifest.xml configuration to check hardware feature requirements and application themes.

steps.title: Building Scan Speak
steps.description: Compile, assemble, and package the debug APK with Gradle 8.5 and Temurin 17.
